glosses: invisible (not visible; which can't be seen)

examples.text: As bactérias são invisíveis a olho nu.
examples.en: Bacteria are invisible to the naked eye.

examples.text: O Tom disse que viu o homem invisível hoje.
examples.en: Tom said he saw the invisible man today.

examples.text: Se eu fosse invisível, não precisaria me vestir.
examples.en: If I were invisible I wouldn't have to dress myself.
